title: ::: PSS-OFF 영어듣기훈련프로그램 | PASS-OFF ENGLISH | 제 001 회 강의 :::
label: [ PASSOFF- 111 ]

blocks.text: The weekends are the best part of my week.
On Saturdays, we only go to school in the morning.
Once we come home for lunch, we are free for the day.
We don’t have to attend any academies!
I usually hang out with my friends on Saturdays.
Sometimes if there is a special day like a birthday party,
we celebrate it on a Saturday afternoon.
We oftentimes go to the karaoke room for these occasions.
I also spend a lot of time on the computer on Saturdays, too.
